claims.claim: Multilayer network models distinguish entities, layers, node-layer tuples, intralayer links and interlayer couplings.
claims.locator: Kivelä et al. (2014), taxonomy and general multilayer framework

claims.claim: Supra adjacency representations can use layer diagonal blocks and interlayer off-diagonal coupling blocks.
claims.locator: De Domenico et al. (2013), mathematical multilayer formalization

claims.claim: Multiplex, interdependent and networks-of-networks models do not assign identical semantics to all cross-layer links.
claims.locator: Kivelä et al. (2014), terminology and taxonomy

claims.claim: The teaching supra graph has 4 real actors, 2 layers, 8 node-layer states, 4 intralayer and 4 identity cross-layer edges.
claims.locator: Derived from explicitly enumerated network and NetworkX construction oracle

claims.claim: From (B,social) to (D,collab), the legal supra path uses three unit-cost edges; flattening gives two, disabling switching makes the state pair disconnected.
claims.locator: Derived via NetworkX shortest_path and has_path on three specified graphs
